# PublicationReadinessRecommendation 1.0.0

Purpose: communicate a governance recommendation to a later backend boundary;
it never publishes content or creates a release.

Canonical identifier:
`urn:neuralverse:xfi:contract:publication-readiness-recommendation:1.0.0`
Semantic owner: governance authority within the Agent & Content Platform.
Implemented consumers: neutral validation and preservation tooling only.
Future consumers: BIP publication intake after separate adoption approval.

The exact nine recommendation values, package linkage, structured quality-gate
results, unresolved findings and unknowns, manual review requirements, accepted
minor backlog, source/asset/assessment/laboratory/governance coverage and
rationale are preserved. Blocked states cannot be converted to ready states by
this schema or the example runner. No publication release identity, published
state, backend persistence identity or execution action is represented.

Coverage is bounded from 0 to 1 when evaluated and explicitly marked when not
applicable or not evaluated. Optional review fields remain absent when omitted;
null is not silently introduced. The shared metadata envelope and namespaced
extensions are required for forward compatibility.
